title: fix(brains): genContextBrain resolves a /latest choice via each package's declared latest map
description:
# 🌙 dream: `genContextBrain` looks up a `latest` slug itself

- **kind** = `reseed`
- **owner** = `ehmpathy/rhachet` — the brain lookup behind `genContextBrain`
- **caught** 2026-09-26, at stone `5.1.execution.from_vision` of `v2026_09_20.review-cost-meter`

## .the cue that fired

the wisher asked for every default brain to be versionless (seed S21). `genContextBrain({ choice:
'fireworks/deepseek/flash/latest' })` throws `BrainChoiceNotFoundError`, although
`rhachet-brains-fireworksai` ships `PINNED_BY_LATEST_SLUG` and its own `genBrainAtom` accepts `latest`.

## .the gap, precisely

the lookup matches a choice by EXACT slug among the registered atoms, and brain packages register
pinned slugs only. so every consumer that wants a versionless default must pin at its own edge —
this repo now carries `getOneBrainChoicePinned`, with a provider → package map it should not own.

## .the shape of the fix

in the lookup, before the exact match: when the choice ends in `/latest`, ask each discovered brain
package for its latest map (a declared export, e.g. `PINNED_BY_LATEST_SLUG`) and pin the choice.
list `latest` aliases in `getAvailableBrainsInWords`, so the error that names the options names them.

## .why it is not done in this round

another repo. once it lands, `getOneBrainChoicePinned` and its `PACKAGE_BY_PROVIDER` map retire.
